## Episode Thesis

Morning news briefing (2026-09-09) led by geopolitics. Brent crude is near $100 after the US destroyed Iranian oil tankers and Iran fired missiles at Jordan, and the US-Canada trade war has escalated. Wall Street fell as the US 10-year yield briefly broke 4.80%, while Asian chip stocks rose on AI optimism. Company news covers US tech and medtech, Rusta's report, Implantica's capital markets day and Handelsbanken's forecast of Riksbank rate hikes. Stockholm is expected to open lower. The host gives no investment recommendations; the only directional view is a cited analyst upgrade of Intel.
